why: BSV2-TARGET-1 (review): the preparation a machine gets for a series, once the size of its target is known. On v5 the Windows page file moves when the target size has no temporary disk (Bsv2, or a v5 size with no d), although the scan names pagefile for v6 and v7 only. The engine (Resolve-VmfEntryClassification -TargetDiskArch) and the page (migrations.html judgeForSeries) are both held to these cases.
